title: The school garden
passage:
The school garden opened in May. Students grow tomatoes, beans and herbs, and the kitchen uses them in school lunches.

Volunteers water the beds every morning before lessons. In the summer holidays, families take turns to look after the garden.
topic: How the garden is looked after
option1: Volunteers water the beds every morning
option3: Families take turns in the summer holidays
option4: Tomatoes, beans and herbs are grown
option6: Vegetables are used in school lunches
explanation:
Options 1, 3 and 5 are about looking after the garden.

The others are true, but they are about what the garden is or what it grows.
